criteria.title: Does the watches work
criteria.description: Wind the crown, the watch should start moving

criteria.title: Serial Number
criteria.description: Check for 7-8 digits, verify against manufacturer records or databases.

criteria.title: Model and Reference Number
criteria.description: Confirm matches official specs; watch for incorrect digits, common in fakes.

criteria.title: Brand Logos and Engravings
criteria.description: Inspect for accuracy, quality; look for misspellings or poor engraving.

criteria.title: Case Back
criteria.description: Check for specific engravings, hallmarks; ensure secure attachment.

criteria.title: Crown and Push Buttons
criteria.description: Verify smooth operation, correct branding; feel for quality.

criteria.title: Dial and Hands
criteria.description: Inspect print quality, hand design; check luminescence.

criteria.title: Movement
criteria.description: Have a professional inspect; verify caliber matches model.

criteria.title: Weight and Feel
criteria.description: Ensure hefty, substantial feel; compare to known authentic models.

criteria.title: Luminescence
criteria.description: Check if hands and markers glow correctly under light.

criteria.title: Box and Papers
criteria.description: Verify original box, warranty card, certificate match watch details.
